annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2026/2274 on the harmonised standards for high-risk AI systems drafted in support of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689
annotation.title_en: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2026/2274 on the harmonised standards for high-risk AI systems drafted in support of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union
annotation.summary_en: Commission Implementing Decision publishing in the Official Journal the reference of harmonised standard EN 18286:2026 (AI quality management system) drafted by CEN and Cenelec in support of the EU AI Act. Compliance gives presumption of conformity with the corresponding high-risk AI requirements. Enters into force on publication.
key_provisions_or_claims: Publishes the reference of EN 18286:2026 (AI quality management system) in the Official Journal
Compliance with the standard gives presumption of conformity under AI Act Article 40
Standard assessed as satisfying the requirements of Implementing Decision C(2025) 3871 standardisation request
Decision enters into force on the day of publication
